Complete [[Warband of Brothers]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Rescue three warband members from the [[Cathedral of Flames]] in the [[Charr Homelands|Charr homelands]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 1,500 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[Warband of Brothers#Walkthrough|Warband of Brothers]] quest.
